title: What Asteroid Habitat Designs Is
definition: Asteroid Habitat Designs: designs for habitats in asteroids.
description:
Asteroid Habitat Designs is designs for habitats in asteroids. It sits squarely in Future Architecture & Building, the frontier where rock shells science becomes design logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are mining integration-scale. Societies that master design hulls early will shape spin gravity practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. t: Real Research Today: Asteroid Habitat Designs
title: Real Research Today: Asteroid Habitat Designs
definition: Today's documented research behind Asteroid Habitat Designs.
description:
The road to Asteroid Habitat Designs is already being paved. Earthship and passive-house movements prove ultra-low-energy building. Mass timber towers (Mjøstårnet Norway, Ascent Milwaukee) prove tall wood buildings.

Self-healing concrete and bio-cement (bioMASON) cut construction emissions. Together these programs form the rock shells foundation that Asteroid Habitat Designs will build on — the design logistics results, the spin gravity methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as design logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Asteroid Habitat Designs
definition: Estimates Asteroid Habitat Designs readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Asteroid Habitat Designs components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a design hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Asteroid Habitat Designs Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Asteroid Habitat Designs operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Asteroid Habitat Designs installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 80708 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where rock shells monitoring, design logistics redundancy, or spin gravity maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Asteroid Habitat Designs Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Asteroid Habitat Designs: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Asteroid Habitat Designs — designs for habitats in asteroids.

Phase 1 — Prove (rock shells): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (design logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (spin gravity): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (mining integration): design hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and space-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
